capabilities: Set a default view per note or folder from the file-explorer context menu
Resolve view rules with note rules first, then deepest folder, then global default
Apply rules to tabs restored at startup and when navigating into open tabs
Manage note and folder rule tables in settings
Set or clear a note's default view via commands
disambiguation: Not a theming or appearance plugin; it only controls whether notes open in editing or reading mode.
extras: Community directory submission is pending, so installation currently requires a manual download from GitHub releases. Only Markdown notes are affected; PDFs, canvases, and images are ignored.
problem: Obsidian's default view setting is global, and the frontmatter workaround for per-note defaults requires editing each note's properties.
summary: Per-note and per-folder rule plugin that sets a default editing or reading view for notes without using frontmatter.
